in_marathi.name: Haripriya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Haripriya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Haripriya is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Harini' and 'Priya'. 'Harini' means 'Goddess of Gods - Parvati' and 'Priya' means 'beloved'. So, Haripriya can be interpreted as 'Goddess Parvati, who is beloved'.
